apple_pie.notes: Sugared cooked apples in a buttery, lightly salted crust; the filling is juicy.

baby_back_ribs.notes: Sugary BBQ glaze over a salt rub; the charred, smoky bark adds bitterness.

baklava.notes: Pastry soaked in honey or sugar syrup with nuts: about as sweet as dishes get.

beef_carpaccio.notes: Raw beef with parmesan for salt and a pile of arugula, a strongly bitter green.

beef_tartare.notes: Raw, moist beef seasoned with capers, mustard and Worcestershire; salty, a bit sharp.

beet_salad.notes: Beets carry real sugar (~7%); bitter leaves and salty goat cheese pull the other way.

beignets.notes: Fried dough buried in powdered sugar; dry and sweet.

bibimbap.notes: Sweet-hot gochujang and soy-seasoned vegetables over rice; greens add some bitterness.

bread_pudding.notes: Bread soaked in sweet custard, often with caramel or raisins; moist.

breakfast_burrito.notes: Eggs, cheese, sausage or bacon and potato in a tortilla: salty and savoury.

bruschetta.notes: Juicy tomatoes on toasted, slightly charred bread; balsamic adds a touch of sugar.

caesar_salad.notes: Romaine is mildly bitter; parmesan, anchovy dressing and croutons bring the salt.

cannoli.notes: Fried shell filled with sweetened ricotta; chocolate chips are mostly sugar.

caprese_salad.notes: Tomato and fresh mozzarella are both very wet; a balsamic drizzle adds sweetness.

carrot_cake.notes: Sweet spiced cake under cream-cheese frosting; the carrots add sugar, not bitterness.

ceviche.notes: Raw fish sitting in salted lime juice; the sourness has no channel here, the wetness does.

cheese_plate.notes: Aged cheeses are very salty; grapes or fig jam add a little sugar, blue cheese some bitterness.

cheesecake.notes: Sweetened cream cheese on a buttery crumb base; dense rather than wet.

chicken_curry.notes: Salted, saucy and spiced; turmeric and fenugreek add slight bitterness.

chicken_quesadilla.notes: Melted cheese and seasoned chicken in a toasted tortilla: salty and dry.

chicken_wings.notes: Fried skin with a salty buffalo or soy glaze; some char.

chocolate_cake.notes: Lots of sugar, but cocoa brings theobromine and caffeine, classic fly-bitter compounds.

chocolate_mousse.notes: Usually dark chocolate: less sugar than cake and more cocoa bitterness.

churros.notes: Fried dough rolled in cinnamon sugar, often dipped in chocolate; dry.

clam_chowder.notes: Creamy, salty soup with briny clams; mostly liquid.

club_sandwich.notes: Bacon and turkey bring salt; lettuce and tomato a little moisture; toast a little char.

crab_cakes.notes: Sweet crab meat, but seasoned and pan-fried; salt dominates.

creme_brulee.notes: Sweet custard; the torched sugar crust is caramelised to the edge of bitter.

croque_madame.notes: Ham, gruyere and bechamel with a fried egg: very salty.

cup_cakes.notes: Sweet cake under a thick cap of frosting, which is mostly sugar.

deviled_eggs.notes: Egg yolk mashed with mayonnaise, mustard and salt.

donuts.notes: Fried dough with glaze or sugar coating: sugar with nothing bitter, and dry.

dumplings.notes: Steamed and juicy, with a salty soy-vinegar dip.

edamame.notes: Boiled young soybeans showered in salt; mildly sweet beans.

eggs_benedict.notes: Ham and buttery hollandaise are salty; a runny yolk adds moisture.

escargots.notes: Snails drowned in garlic-parsley butter; salty fat.

falafel.notes: Fried chickpea balls with cumin and herbs; tahini sauce is noticeably bitter.

filet_mignon.notes: Seared crust gives some char bitterness; a lean, juicy cut seasoned with salt.

fish_and_chips.notes: Battered fried fish and chips, salted and splashed with malt vinegar.

foie_gras.notes: Rich salted liver, usually served with a sweet fruit compote or brioche.

french_fries.notes: Fried potato and salt, nothing else.

french_onion_soup.notes: Caramelised onions are sweet, the beef broth and gruyere are salty; wine adds a little bitterness.

french_toast.notes: Egg-soaked bread fried in butter, then syrup and powdered sugar.

fried_calamari.notes: Battered, fried and salted squid, with lemon.

fried_rice.notes: Rice fried with soy sauce and oil: salty, not wet.

frozen_yogurt.notes: Sweetened, tart and melts to liquid; toppings add more sugar.

gnocchi.notes: Potato dumplings; the sauce sets the taste, usually butter-sage or tomato.

greek_salad.notes: Feta and olives are very salty, cucumber and tomato very wet; olives and raw onion are somewhat bitter.

grilled_cheese_sandwich.notes: Buttered toast and melted cheese: salt and fat.

grilled_salmon.notes: Salted fish with charred grill marks.

guacamole.notes: Avocado mashed with lime and salt, usually eaten off salty chips.

gyoza.notes: Pan-fried dumplings with a browned bottom, dipped in soy.

hamburger.notes: Salted, char-grilled patty; ketchup adds a little sugar, pickles some salt.

hot_and_sour_soup.notes: Salty broth with vinegar and white pepper; mostly liquid.

hot_dog.notes: Cured sausage in a soft bun with ketchup and mustard: salt first.

huevos_rancheros.notes: Fried eggs on tortillas with salsa and beans; saucy and salted.

hummus.notes: Chickpeas with salt and lemon; tahini (sesame paste) is the bitter note.

ice_cream.notes: Very sugary and melts to a sweet liquid.

lasagna.notes: Cheese and meat sauce are salty; cooked tomato adds a little sugar.

lobster_bisque.notes: Creamy shellfish soup finished with sherry or brandy; sweet lobster, salty base.

lobster_roll_sandwich.notes: Sweet lobster meat with mayo or butter in a toasted, buttered roll.

macaroni_and_cheese.notes: Pasta in a salty cheese sauce.

macarons.notes: Almond meringue shells and filling, overwhelmingly sugar.

miso_soup.notes: Salty fermented soybean paste dissolved in dashi; almost all water.

mussels.notes: Steamed in white wine and their own briny juice; wet and salty.

nachos.notes: Salted chips with cheese and jalapenos: a salt delivery system.

omelette.notes: Salted eggs, sometimes with cheese or ham; soft and moist.

onion_rings.notes: Fried, salted batter around onion, whose sugars sweeten on cooking.

oysters.notes: Raw in their own seawater liquor: briny and wet.

pad_thai.notes: Palm sugar and tamarind against fish sauce: sweet and salty together.

paella.notes: Rice in salty stock with seafood; saffron and the toasted crust are slightly bitter.

pancakes.notes: Mildly sweet batter, made sweet by maple syrup.

panna_cotta.notes: Sweetened cream set with gelatin, usually under a berry sauce; very moist.

peking_duck.notes: Maltose-glazed, roasted crisp skin with sweet hoisin; some roast bitterness.

pho.notes: Big bowl of salty beef broth with noodles and herbs.

pizza.notes: Cheese and cured toppings are salty; tomato sauce adds a little sugar; charred crust a little bitterness.

pork_chop.notes: Salted, seared meat; not much else.

poutine.notes: Salted fries, cheese curds and gravy: very salty, partly wet.

prime_rib.notes: Salt-crusted roast beef served with jus.

pulled_pork_sandwich.notes: Smoked pork in sweet BBQ sauce on a soft bun.

ramen.notes: Noodles in a very salty broth.

ravioli.notes: Cheese- or meat-filled pasta in butter or tomato sauce.

red_velvet_cake.notes: Very sweet cake and cream-cheese frosting; only a little cocoa.

risotto.notes: Rice cooked in salty stock with parmesan; creamy and loose.

samosa.notes: Fried pastry with spiced potato and peas; tamarind chutney on the side.

sashimi.notes: Plain raw fish, moist and barely salted; the soy and wasabi are on the side.

scallops.notes: Naturally sweet (glycogen) and seared to a browned crust.

seaweed_salad.notes: Salty sea vegetables in a sugar, vinegar and sesame dressing.

shrimp_and_grits.notes: Cheesy grits with bacon and shrimp: salty and soft.

spaghetti_bolognese.notes: Meat-and-tomato sauce, slowly cooked; tomato gives a little sugar.

spaghetti_carbonara.notes: Guanciale and pecorino are both very salty; black pepper is sharp.

spring_rolls.notes: Fried or fresh rolls with a sweet chili or fish-sauce dip.

steak.notes: Salted, charred crust (Maillard and char compounds lean bitter) over juicy meat.

strawberry_shortcake.notes: Sugared, juicy strawberries with whipped cream and sweet biscuit.

sushi.notes: Rice seasoned with sugar, salt and vinegar; soy dip adds salt.

tacos.notes: Seasoned meat with salsa and lime; salty, a little juicy.

takoyaki.notes: Octopus batter balls under sweet-salty sauce, mayo and bonito flakes.

tiramisu.notes: Sweet mascarpone, but espresso-soaked biscuits and cocoa dusting bring caffeine bitterness.

tuna_tartare.notes: Raw tuna in soy-sesame dressing; moist and salty.

waffles.notes: Crisp sweet batter with syrup or powdered sugar.
